image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a green, algae-covered rocky surface. The crab's broad oval carapace is purplish-brown with lighter mottled patterns. Its five pairs of walking legs extend laterally, with the first pair modified into robust claws. The claws appear to have dark tips. The crab's eyes are stalked and protrude from the anterior margin of the carapace. The ventral surface is partially visible and appears cream to white.
